Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun deep burgundy hair — full body melting swirled hard candy fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real hard candy curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, thick glossy sugar syrup in pink and white swirls slowly stretching and dripping down her body in long sticky strands and pooling in shining puddles around her feet, nothing lying flat. Dense surface — BLAZING bubblegum-pink and cream-white swirled stripes of glossy molten sugar across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID clear sugar-glass edges glinting along the swirls and tiny rainbow sprinkles caught in the sticky surface, with fine edible gold-leaf flecks scattered across the surface, high-gloss sticky, richly saturated in colour, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: turned in profile, back arched, looking over her shoulder, one hand on her hip — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same hard candy, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same hard candy with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT candy — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: neon-bright saturated orange-red lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, bold golden-peach eyeshadow, dramatic lashes, a glowing warm blush.

Background: a bright observatory hall with a pale floor, a large white telescope dome behind her, a standard-height door and a short steel stair, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
